title: Lecturer on Law
bio: In addition to being a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, Debbie Goldstein is a Lecturer on Education at the Harvard Graduate School of Education. She has also taught at Tufts University School of Medicine and Georgetown University Law Center. She is the Managing Partner of Triad Consulting, a leadership development consulting firm, helping […]
